a: Startup probes delay liveness checks for slow-starting apps.
ResourceQuotas limit total resources in a namespace.
LimitRanges set default and max request/limit ranges.
Topology spread constraints distribute pods across zones.
minAvailable keeps a minimum number of pods during disruptions.
Policies can restrict both ingress and egress traffic.
Ingress can terminate TLS with secrets.
kubectl rollout status watches deployment progress.
